name: trikekoto-rules-tests
description: Security-rules unit tests for TrikeKoTo, run against the Firestore emulator.

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --only firestore,auth --project trikekoto-rules-test "npm run test:mocha"
scripts.test:mocha: mocha --timeout 30000 rules.test.mjs lifecycle.test.mjs attacks.test.mjs migration.test.mjs riders.test.mjs
